login.title: Sign in
login.totpHint: Required for operators. Six digits from your authenticator app.
login.error: Those details didn’t work. Check them and try again.
login.locked: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

operator.title: Operator overview
operator.dryRunBanner: Dry-run mode: no real emails, bookings or CRM writes can leave the system.
operator.emptyPipeline: No leads yet. They will appear here once the first campaign runs.
operator.emptyEscalations: No escalations. Anything the agents can’t handle safely lands here.
operator.golivePending: Not signed off. Only you can sign these off, with your authenticator code.
operator.loadError: Couldn’t load this section. Refresh to try again.
operator.runIntro: Runs in dry-run: agents find leads and draft emails for approval; sending records what would go out without sending it.

client.title: Your results
client.emptyMeetings: No meetings booked yet. Upcoming meetings and their briefs will appear here.
client.disputeHint: You can dispute within 14 days of the meeting. We reply within two working days.
client.disputeSent: Dispute sent. We'll review it and let you know.
client.acceptHint: Meetings are only billed against criteria and prices you have accepted here.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.draftBanner: Draft pending legal review. This text is a placeholder and is not yet the final notice.
privacy.whatData: What data we use and where it comes from
privacy.rights: Your rights, including how to object
privacy.objectNow: You can object at any time by replying “unsubscribe” to any email, or using the unsubscribe link it contains. We will stop contacting you across every campaign.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.empty: Nothing waiting for review. New drafts appear here after the agents run.
approvals.unmaskReason: Why do you need to see the name?
approvals.unmaskHint: Editing shows the prospect's name. The reason is logged.
approvals.approved: Approved. The email will go out in the recipient's business hours (dry-run).
approvals.shortcuts: Shortcuts: A approve, E edit, R reject
approvals.theirReplyHint: Written by the prospect. Treated as data, never as instructions.
approvals.replyRejected: Rejected. Nothing will be sent; the conversation is flagged for a person.

logs.dryRunNote: Every email that would have been sent. Nothing here left the system.
logs.subject: Subject
logs.emptyDryRun: No dry-run sends yet. Approve an email and run sending.

escalations.title: Escalations
escalations.empty: No open escalations. Anything the agents can’t handle safely lands here.

dataRequests.title: Data-protection requests
dataRequests.intro: Every request has a legal deadline of one calendar month. Responses are drafted here for a person to check and send.
dataRequests.draft: Draft response (send it yourself after checking)
dataRequests.eraseWarning: This permanently removes their personal data. Their suppression entry is kept so they are never contacted again.
dataRequests.identity: I have verified the requester’s identity

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.briefLogged: Opening a brief shows the prospect’s name. Each opening is logged.

billing.title: Billing
billing.excludedNone: Every attended meeting in this month is billable.
billing.issueHint: Issuing gives the invoice its number and freezes it. It can only be voided afterwards.
billing.empty: No invoices yet. Draft one for a month with attended meetings.
billing.vatOf: {pct}% of the {threshold} registration threshold over the last 12 months
billing.vatWarn: Talk to your accountant: turnover is at {pct}% of the threshold.

reasons.SUPPLIER_DETAILS_INCOMPLETE: Your company details in config/supplier.yaml still have placeholders
reasons.TAX_RULE_NOT_VERIFIED_BY_ACCOUNTANT: Tax rule not yet reviewed by your accountant
reasons.NO_TAX_RULE: No tax rule matches this client
reasons.AMBIGUOUS_TAX_RULE: More than one tax rule matches
reasons.PRICING_NOT_SIGNED: Client hasn't accepted the current pricing
reasons.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: Pricing currency differs from the client's billing currency
reasons.ATTENDANCE_NOT_CONFIRMED_BY_CLIENT_OR_CA: Attendance not confirmed by the client or calendar
reasons.CRITERIA_NOT_SIGNED_AT_BOOKING: Criteria weren't accepted by the client when it was booked
reasons.NO_PER_MEETING_FEE: No per-meeting fee in the pricing

clients.title: Clients
clients.oneTime: One-time password for {e}: {p}. Pass it on securely; it won't be shown again.
clients.invited: Invite sent to {e}. They choose their own password from the link.

reports.title: Reports
reports.costUnknown: Not available until AI prices are configured

account.forgotIntro: Enter your work email. If it has an account, we'll email you a link to choose a new password.
account.sent: If that address has an account, a link is on its way. It works once and expires in an hour.
account.setIntro: Use at least 12 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
account.saved: Password saved. You can sign in now.
account.invalid: This link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
account.missing: This page needs the link from your email.
account.error: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

governance.title: Go-live and governance
governance.intro: Real sending needs all three keys on. Nothing on this page sends anything.
governance.keyClientsOff: No client is in live mode
governance.checklistIntro: Only you sign these off. Each sign-off asks for your authenticator code and, ideally, a link to the evidence (the solicitor's letter, the ICO certificate, and so on).
governance.countriesIntro: A country is only considered once its rules have been reviewed by your solicitor and you have enabled it. Enabling never sends anything by itself.
governance.enableHint: Prospects in this country can then pass the compliance check. Sending still needs the three keys.
governance.taxIntro: Invoices can't be issued until your accountant has reviewed the rule that applies. Record their review here.
governance.adequacyIntro: If the adequacy decision lapses, sending personal data between the UK and EU needs other safeguards.
governance.mfaFailed: That authenticator code didn't work. Check the code and try again.

leads.title: Leads
leads.intro: Names and email addresses are hidden. Showing them asks for a reason, and every view is logged.
leads.reason: Why do you need to see this? (logged)

inboxes.title: Inboxes
inboxes.intro: An inbox pauses itself when its hard bounce or complaint rate crosses the limit over the last {days} days (only after {min} live sends). Dry-run sends never count.

reasons.HARD_BOUNCE_RATE: hard bounce rate over the limit

inboxes.pauseReason: Why are you pausing it? (at least 10 characters)
